Completing the Celebration will remove all decorations, but [[Whispers Between Stars]] will still be available to complete. ==Summary== *This is gathered from the Skip summary {{Description|Lucilla detects a strange frequency not belonging to the Academy in its "Dark Side." Coincidentally, many students have been reporting mental disturbances. Suspecting a connection to the "game" the Grand Architect mentioned, you agree to Lucilla's request and enter the Dark Side to investigate. While exploring, you encounter abnormal Reflections and Tacet Discords. During a confrontation with one of the Tacet Discords, a girl appears and helps you. She insists on guiding you out of the Dark Side. After returning to the real world, you report everything to Lucilla. She identifies the girl you met as Sigrika, a successor to the Heliodic Six. To gather more information about the recent changes within the Dark Side, you head to the celebration venue in search of her. Upon Lynae's suggestion, you meet a girl called Denia. Not long after, you witness Sigrika falling from the sky. Despite earning herself a top position in the event's leaderboard, it's clear that something is bothering Sigrika. Sigrika speaks of the Dark Side's changes, such as the strange runes that keep appearing out of nowhere. While Sigrika is still in the dark about their origin and purpose, they remain a solid lead. She suggests using riddles as a way to get back into the Dark Side. You receive a riddle from the Divinator hinting at a deeper transformation within the Dark Side—it is secretly spawning monsters. Sigrika realizes that the riddle-solving process resembles a game from her childhood and volunteers to guide you through it. After solving several riddles, you reach the final chamber where a floating rune riddle poses its question. But by then, any answer you give, whether right or wrong, gets rejected by the Dark Side all the same. Just when things look grim, a music record appears to guide you safely out. After hearing Lucilla out, you decided to keep investigating the Dark Side. Whatever game the Fractsidus thinks they’re playing, they’re not going to win. Amid the lively and relaxed atmosphere of the celebration, Sigrika opens up about what's been on her mind. Before you can talk long, Lucilla cuts in with an urgent message. Several students' signals have vanished within the Dark Side, and at each disappearance site, Lucilla discovers a riddle. Following its lead, you must re-enter the Dark Side to rescue them. Isla later confesses her own struggles to you, hoping you might have an answer for her. Sigrika awakens from a dream to find herself trapped in a classroom, surrounded by teachers, friends, and classmates, all waiting for her response. Sigrika realizes that she’s still in the Dark Side, trapped in a nightmare. In the nightmare, Sigrika comes to believe that all the Dark Side's changes are being caused by herself. When Sigrika wakes up in the real world, you're there to comfort her. You tell her that even if you can't give her a "right" answer, you'll help her face whatever comes next. This isn't about getting it right or wrong. It's about going all the way, so neither of you has any regrets. Lucilla invites you to watch a movie with her. She speaks again of Sigrika's situation and confirms that the Reflections and Tacet Discord you ran into back in the Dark Side are the real source of the incident. You visit the Divinator together with Sigrika to decipher the final riddle. After sitting with it for a few days, Sigrika finally shares what she thinks the answer could be. You decide to confront the vortex in the Dark Side together. You find the entrance rune. Sigrika takes a breath, steadies herself, and together you step back into the Dark Side. You follow a rabbit deeper and deeper until you discover Sigrika trapped within the vortex. In desperation, you shout out her name. With the Dark Side closing in around her, it's the sound of her friends calling out that helps Sigrika find her own answer. You resolve the issue of the vortex and leave the Academy's Dark Side behind. There might still be a few ripples left, but the real danger is over. For now, at least, you can enjoy a quiet night.
